props.gloss_en: rams may go out [on Shabbat] levuvin
and ewes may go out shechuzot
this 'levuvin' is an expression of closeness
as it is written: 'you have libavtini, my sister, my bride' (Song 4:9)
Ulla: levuvin is hide that one ties to them over their heart
Ulla: [it is tied] so that wolves will not fall upon them
[wolves fall on the males] because they walk at the head of the flock
rather: [wolves fall on the males] because they are fat
rather: [wolves fall on the males] because they raise their noses and walk looking about
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: levuvin is hide that one ties to them under their male organ
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: [it is tied] so that they will not mount the females
shechuzot means that they hold their tails up
[the tails are held up] so that the males will mount them
this 'shechuzot' is an expression of exposure
as it is written: 'and behold, a woman met him, in the attire of a harlot (shit zona) and wily of heart' (Prov 7:10)
